guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 假想檢核 1：下沉驅動與力系平衡；netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN
假想檢核 2：側摩阻與埋深累積；skinResistance=tau*pi*D*depth=15 kPa*pi*10 m*20 m=9425 kN
假想檢核 3：刃腳環帶與局部支承；annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa
假想檢核 4：井體傾斜與共同基準；tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad
假想檢核 5：井底滲流與有效應力；upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00
假想檢核 6：降水固結與鄰近沉陷；settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m
CEDD 岩洞指南第二版出版於 2018 年，並非本課的實測報告
FHWA 官方典藏將隧道土木手冊出版日期記為 2009 年
factsEn: Assumed check 1: Sinking drive and force equilibrium; netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN
Assumed check 2: Skin resistance and embedded depth; skinResistance=tau*pi*D*depth=15 kPa*pi*10 m*20 m=9425 kN
Assumed check 3: Cutting-edge annulus and local support; annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa
Assumed check 4: Caisson tilt and shared survey datum; tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad
Assumed check 5: Base seepage and effective stress; upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00
Assumed check 6: Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement; settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m
CEDD issued its second cavern guide in 2018; it is not a measurement report for these examples
The FHWA official archive dates the civil tunnel manual to 2009
timeline: 2009　FHWA 公開隧道土木手冊提供地下工程閱讀框架
2013　Heathwall 規劃文件提出沉井及托換方案，非竣工紀錄
2020　Cremorne 業主紀錄樁與噴凝土工法，作為非沉井對照
timelineEn: 2009 — The FHWA civil tunnel manual provides an underground-engineering reading framework
2013 — The Heathwall planning statement proposes caisson and underpinning methods, not an as-built record
2020 — The Cremorne owner records piles and sprayed lining as a non-caisson comparison
codes: FHWA 道路隧道設計與施工土木技術手冊
CEDD 岩土指南第四冊：岩洞工程第二版
codesEn: FHWA Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels - Civil Elements
CEDD Geoguide 4: Guide to Cavern Engineering second edition
landmarks: Heathwall（2013 沉井規劃，非竣工證明）
Cremorne（樁加噴凝土，非沉井對照）
landmarksEn: Heathwall (2013 caisson proposal, not as-built evidence)
Cremorne (piles and sprayed lining, non-caisson comparison)
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：豎井沉井施工
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Sinking-caisson shaft construction
guides.concept: 本課以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為主線，從下沉驅動與力系平衡與側摩阻與埋深累積建立系統邊界，再把井底滲流與有效應力、位移速率與突沉辨識連到永久抗浮與階段交接。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift. It begins with Sinking drive and force equilibrium and Skin resistance and embedded depth, links Base seepage and effective stress and Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection, and ends with Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
procedure: 沉井自重與附加荷載提供下沉作用，浮力、側摩阻與刃腳反力則抵抗移動。各項會隨水位、接觸和土體擾動改變，靜態差值只表示假想瞬間的不平衡；突然卸阻時需要考慮動態和可控性，不能由力差直接決定施工動作。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據；若出現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
井壁與地層摩阻沿周邊和深度分布，不同土層、潤滑和接觸間隙使剪應力非均勻。平均值模型可顯示埋深敏感度，但上下段可能在不同時刻動員；停沉後黏著恢復也會改變再次移動所需力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將土層分段、井壁接觸與停沉前後荷重位移對照；若出現以淺層平均摩阻推估全深，漏掉高黏著層造成懸掛，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
刃腳將井體荷載傳到下方土體，理想環帶面積不等於實際均勻接觸。地層軟硬差、刃角幾何和局部掏空會使壓力集中，還可能引起井壁彎曲；平均承壓只用於檢查量級，不能定義局部挖土範圍。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變；若出現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
井體傾斜由對向高差與水平基線定義，單一側點下沉不能區分整體沉降與轉動。環向多點可檢查是否近似剛體，井壁彎曲或測點鬆動會破壞此假設；量測系統須與影響區外穩定基準連結。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對；若出現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
井內外水頭差沿井底滲流路徑產生梯度，向上滲流降低土體有效應力。平均路徑模型不能代表刃腳附近局部峰值，黏土不排水隆起也不是砂土臨界梯度問題；先辨識土類、方向和破壞機制再比較數值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化；若出現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
井周降水降低孔壓並提高有效應力，可能使可壓縮層固結而影響鄰近設施。線性壓縮模型只適合指定應力範圍和一維假設，實際沉陷還取決於分層、時間與降水範圍；井體本身位移不能代替周邊監測。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊；若出現只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
沉井移動速率需依時間解析度判讀，長時段平均會掩蓋短暫突沉。速率跳變可能來自土阻崩落，也可能是感測器或時鐘異常；應使用同步獨立資料確認，而不是由累積進尺推定整段平順。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量；若出現一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
封底承受向上水壓並把作用傳到井壁或其他核定抗浮系統，自重通常只是抵抗項之一。水下施工階段與排水後壓差不同，不能只確認混凝土厚度就判斷可轉換狀態；黏結、剪力傳遞與齡期強度另需驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭；若出現封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
井壁節段與封底交界可能在下沉、固結和溫度變化時產生相對位移，止水材料需要對應開度與剪切。幾何應變只是形變指標，不能代替產品的循環、黏結或老化試驗；漏點位置還可能是水沿界面遷移後的出口。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係；若出現只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
沉井作為永久豎井後，抗浮依賴最終重量、結構連接及設計水位，施工臨時壓重不能自動列為永久抵抗。重量與浮力比只是未分項平衡，規範組合、耐久和連接強度另行要求；交接需明確哪些抵抗已實際形成。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本；若出現移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
procedureEn: Caisson weight and surcharge drive sinking against buoyancy, skin friction and cutting-edge resistance. Water levels, contact and disturbed soil change these terms. A static difference describes a hypothetical instant, while sudden resistance loss involves dynamics and controllability; imbalance alone cannot prescribe field action. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Wall friction distributes around the perimeter and depth, varying with layers, lubrication and gaps. A mean-stress model shows depth sensitivity, but upper and lower sections mobilize at different times. Adhesion recovered during a pause can further change the force needed to resume movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare layer intervals and wall contact with load-displacement before and after stoppages. If extrapolating shallow mean friction misses a high-adhesion layer that hangs up the caisson, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

The cutting edge transfers load into underlying soil, but its geometric annulus is not necessarily uniformly engaged. Contrasting strata, edge geometry and local voids concentrate pressure and can bend the wall. Mean bearing checks scale only and cannot define a field excavation pattern. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Tilt follows differential elevation over a horizontal baseline, while one sinking point cannot separate translation from rotation. Circumferential points test the rigid-body assumption, which wall bending or loose targets can invalidate. Tie measurements to stable reference points outside the influence zone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Head difference drives base seepage, and upward flow reduces effective stress. An average path misses local gradients near the cutting edge; undrained clay heave is distinct from granular critical-gradient behavior. Identify soil type, flow direction and mechanism before interpreting numerical comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Dewatering reduces pore pressure and increases effective stress, potentially consolidating compressible layers beneath neighboring assets. A linear model assumes a specified stress interval and one-dimensional response. Layering, time and drawdown extent control real settlement; caisson movement cannot substitute for surrounding monitoring. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. If monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Movement rate depends on time resolution, and long averages can hide brief rapid sinking. A rate jump may reflect resistance collapse or sensor and clock error. Confirm it with synchronized independent data rather than inferring smooth motion from total progress over the reporting interval. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys. If a one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

The base plug transfers uplift to the walls or another approved resisting system, with self-weight only one resistance component. Differential pressure changes between underwater and dewatered stages. Thickness alone cannot justify a stage change; bond, shear transfer and age-dependent strength need separate evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head. If insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Wall segments and base interfaces move during sinking, consolidation and temperature changes, requiring seals suited to opening and shear. Geometric strain is a deformation indicator, not a substitute for cyclic, bond or aging tests. A visible leak may be an outlet after migration along an interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations. If checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

As a permanent shaft, uplift resistance depends on final weight, structural connections and design water level. Temporary ballast is not automatically permanent resistance. A raw weight-to-buoyancy ratio omits code combinations, durability and connection checks; handover must identify which resisting mechanisms are actually established. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. If removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
evidence: 將按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將將土層分段、井壁接觸與停沉前後荷重位移對照列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現以淺層平均摩阻推估全深，漏掉高黏著層造成懸掛，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
evidenceEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare layer intervals and wall contact with load-displacement before and after stoppages. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If extrapolating shallow mean friction misses a high-adhesion layer that hangs up the caisson, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
pitfalls: 側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
pitfallsEn: Sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

A one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

related.title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護
related.transfer: 可遷移「下沉驅動與力系平衡」與「位移速率與突沉辨識」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道噴射混凝土支護的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Sinking drive and force equilibrium" and "Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shotcrete tunnel support must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮；隧道噴射混凝土支護則以以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift; Shotcrete tunnel support centres on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「下沉驅動與力系平衡」與「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道噴射混凝土支護，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「芯樣方向與強度換算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sinking drive and force equilibrium” and “Shell action and rock contact”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shotcrete tunnel support, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Core orientation and strength interpretation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 豎井沉井施工
history.text: 本課討論的沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。Heathwall 2013 規劃提出沉井後轉托換，並非竣工證明；Cremorne 2020 紀錄採樁加噴凝土，特列為非沉井對照，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. The Heathwall 2013 proposal combines caisson sinking and underpinning and is not as-built evidence. The Cremorne 2020 account describes piles plus sprayed lining and is expressly a non-caisson comparison. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

references.scope: 第 K.4.24 節提出先沉井後托換的方案；這是 2013 規劃內容，不聲稱為最終竣工方法。
references.scopeEn: Section K.4.24 proposes caisson sinking followed by underpinning; this is a 2013 proposal, not a claim about the final as-built method.

references.title: Tideway Cremorne 豎井完工方法紀錄
references.scope: 2020 年業主說明咬合樁加噴凝土襯砌；本課明確列為非沉井工法對照，不能因同屬 Tideway 就當沉井實例。
references.scopeEn: The 2020 owner account describes secant piles and sprayed lining; explicitly a non-caisson comparison, not evidence that every Tideway shaft was sunk as a caisson.
